messages:
Ana: Heads up — scheduling maintenance tonight 00:30–01:30 UTC for graceful IO-throttle + tenant rotation in us-west2 rack A3. Thermal hotspot observed; targeting shared pools only.

Ana: Plan: cordon cohort, rotate tenants in small batches, apply IO throttle to avoid IO storms, reboot GPUs only if needed, then uncordon after KV-cache backfill. Expect brief <2% p99 blips.

Ana: Run commands: ./infra cordon --region us-west2 --rack A3 --cohort 7; ./ops rotate-tenants --pool shared-saturn --batch-size 8 --concurrency 2; curl -X POST https://infra.api/ops/throttle -d '{"cohort":"A3-7","io_pct":50}'

Sam: Capacity check — can we absorb rotated tenants?

Leah: Baseline ~75% GPU util for shared. Safe to absorb ~6 GPUs concurrently. Stagger batches by 8m to avoid queueing.

Mike: Dedicated pools excluded?

Ana: Confirmed — dedicated-* excluded. Targets: shared-saturn, shared-zephyr, burst-interruptible.

Sam: Prioritize background jobs first, interactive last.

Leah: Adding priority: background > batch > interactive. Scheduler will emit tenant-priority list.

Mike: Rollback if p99 >10% or errors spike?

Ana: Rollback: ./ops job pause JOB-6150004243; ./infra uncordon --region us-west2 --rack A3 --cohort 7; remove throttle with curl. I'll open rollback ticket and tag @oncall.

infra-bot: Scheduled maintenance job JOB-6150004243-IO-ROTATE created (start 6150004200, window 60m).

Sam: Finance note — cost bump?

Leah: Estimate ~3% extra GPU-hours (~$3k–$5k). Will publish final after run.

Mike: I'll canary; watching p99 and GPU temps. If temps persist after two cohorts we escalate to hardware.

deploy-bot: Deploy lock for us-west2 cohorts 00:20–01:40 UTC.

Ana: I'll post start/mid/end updates to #incidents. Ping me if p99 >2% or error spike >1%.
